title: Are the cookies installed by materialdesignicons.com really necessary?
body:
As a result of the new eurpean GDPR regulation, we need to have more control over the cookies in our sites.

I've noticed that 2 cookies are installed by materialdesignicons.com. Are they really necessary in a static site? How can I avoid them to be installed in my deployed site?
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Buefy lib doesn't provide material design icons so you can choose as you want
